canonical_definition:
Space of definitions. In the available usage, turn-taking is treated as managing dialogue turns in a smooth, human-like way during interaction. One paper further describes seamless conversational turn-taking as a high-level cue, and characterizes conversational bots that follow the conversation flow as generally rated as more engaging and trustworthy.

Variants. The only label used here is conversational turn-taking.

Space of elicitation and scores. No measurement instrument is linked to it in the papers.

What it is taken as evidence of. No construct is linked to it as evidence of in the papers.
